name: PM-KISAN
summary: Direct income support for eligible land-holding cultivator families across India.
benefit: ₹6,000 per eligible family per year delivered in three equal quad-monthly installments, subject to official landholding verification.
eligibility_note: Operational landholder farmer families subject to statutory exclusion criteria (institutional holders, tax-payers, constitutional post holders).

name: Telangana Rythu Bharosa
summary: Telangana State agricultural input investment assistance for cultivating landholders.
benefit: Financial assistance per cultivated acre per year as notified under current state guidelines, conditional on field verification.
eligibility_note: Pattadar passbook holders and verified tenant cultivators cultivating agricultural land in Telangana.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
summary: Comprehensive yield and localized risk crop insurance for notified agricultural seasons and areas.
benefit: Loss compensation based on threshold yield deficit or localized calamity survey within 72 hours; nominal 1.5% - 2% premium for food/oilseed crops.
eligibility_note: Farmers growing notified crops in notified insurance units holding insurable interest (sharecroppers and tenant farmers eligible with proof).

name: Andhra Pradesh Rythu Bharosa
summary: State investment assistance provided to farmer and tenant families in Andhra Pradesh.
benefit: Input subsidy assistance provided annually in seasonal installments, subject to district revenue record verification and government notification.
eligibility_note: Land-owning cultivator families and registered tenant farmers (CCRC cardholders) with verified active cultivation in AP.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
summary: Institutional short-term crop loans with interest subvention to meet seasonal cultivation and farm maintenance needs.
benefit: Revolving credit limit with concessional effective interest rate as low as 4% per annum upon prompt repayment (up to ₹3 Lakh limit).
eligibility_note: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and self-help groups (SHG) / Joint Liability Groups (JLG) cultivating crops or allied activities.

name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
summary: Pan-India electronic trading portal integrating physical APMC mandis for transparent competitive discovery.
benefit: Single-window online trading access to inter-state buyers, unified mandi license, quality assaying, and direct online bank payments without middleman commission.
eligibility_note: Open to all cultivators bringing harvested produce to e-NAM connected wholesale agricultural markets with lot registration.

name: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana
summary: Voluntary, contributory pension social security scheme for small and marginal landholders.
benefit: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining 60 years of age, backed by matching 50:50 central government contribution.
eligibility_note: Small and marginal farmers aged 18 to 40 years possessing cultivable land up to 2 hectares in state land records.

name: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (Micro Irrigation)
summary: Capital subsidies for drip and sprinkler irrigation installations to maximize farm water efficiency.
benefit: Financial subsidy ranging from 45% to 55% (often topped up by AP & Telangana state programs up to 70%-90% for smallholders) on approved micro-irrigation systems.
eligibility_note: Farmers having assured water source and cultivable land; small/marginal/SC/ST cultivators receive higher subsidy priority.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
summary: Scientific soil nutrient status testing and customized dosage recommendations for individual farm holdings.
benefit: Free/subsidized comprehensive testing of 12 soil chemical parameters (N, P, K, micro-nutrients, pH, EC) with customized fertilizer dosage prescriptions.
eligibility_note: All farmers with active agricultural parcels within the periodic grid sampling coverage of state agriculture departments.

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY-RAFTAAR)
summary: State-flexible funding for agricultural infrastructure, post-harvest drying yards, Custom Hiring Centers, and agri-entrepreneurship.
benefit: Capital grants and subsidies for community farm infrastructure, Custom Hiring Center (CHC) equipment procurement, and farm-gate primary processing.
eligibility_note: Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), village agricultural cooperative societies, CHC entrepreneurs, and recognized cultivator groups.
